title: A Threshold Model for Micrometeoroid Atmospheric Entry: Filippov Dynamics, Survival Estimates, and Survivor-Only Inverse Limits
summary: Micrometeoroids enter Earth's atmosphere at hypervelocity speeds and experience rapid coupling between drag, heating, radiation, melting, ablation, and deceleration. This paper develops a reduced threshold model for the thermal survival boundary of spherical micrometeoroids. The model uses free molecular drag, an exponential atmosphere, projected-area heating, full-sphere radiative cooling, and a surplus-heat ablation rule at the melting temperature.
